verdict.rationale: Lever ships discrete built-in AI features that do tasks for the user. The AI Form Builder generates a form from a plain-language description, AI generates interview guides, and AI produces interview transcripts and summaries. There is no evidence of a general-purpose in-product assistant that takes delegated tasks across the product; Automation Hub is rule-based automation, not an AI assistant. Missing for 10: a general conversational/agentic assistant, delegation of multi-step tasks across product areas, documentation of how users direct the AI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: With the AI Form Builder, just describe the form you need, and it's generated instantly
